ValidationRule.description: When "Other Use Case" is the selected value from the picklist field Primary Use Cases/Why Tanium this field must give the Other Use Case.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( INCLUDES( Primary_Use_Cases_Why_Tanium__c , "OTHER - If OTHER list additional use case(s)") , ISBLANK ( OTHER_List_Additional_Use_Cases__c ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You must enter the Other Use Case when you select "Other - If Other list additional Use Case" for the value.
